rubric: Tark benchmark rubric, 12 points: strategy match 3 (gate below 2), risk/liquidity match 3, investability 2, data quality 2, provider independence 2, threshold 7/12
declared_none_reason: cell 5.1: documented absence of a self-declared benchmark

primary.candidate: Senior loan investable proxy (BKLN, for Morningstar LSTA class)
reasons: strategy_match 2/3: the public-market version of the asset class (syndicated loans for multi-sector credit)
risk_liquidity_match 1/3: daily-liquid market proxy vs a semi-liquid NAV fund, vol and liquidity regimes differ
investability 2/2: computable on held data (daily series)
provider_independence 2/2: provider unaffiliated with the fund (Invesco / Morningstar LSTA class): the registry affiliation map ties it to none of the fund's advisers

comparison.comparator_kind: public market series (exchange-traded proxy, Yahoo adjusted close)
comparison.fund_return_source: Yahoo adjusted close, approximates NAV total return
comparison.window_note: clipped: proxy series begins 2018-07-18, proxy series ends 2026-07-17
comparison.schedule_note: ILLUSTRATIVE: 97 equal contributions, at the window start and each month-end inside it, valued at the window end. The two-point figure is primary.

secondary.candidate: Peer composite, private credit cohort without PIMCO Flexible Credit Income Fund (members: Blackstone Private Credit Fund, CION Ares Diversified Credit Fund, Cliffwater Corporate Lending Fund, Blue Owl Credit Income Corp.)
reasons: strategy_match 2/3: same asset class, different sub-strategy (direct lending vs multi-sector credit)
risk_liquidity_match 2/3: NAV-class series, annual observations vs the fund's daily return data and members span more than one leverage regime
investability 2/2: computable on held data (cohort composite from filings)
data_quality 1/2: annual composite with 5 overlapping fiscal years

provider_independence 1/2: constructed by the evaluator from the roster, not a third-party index. A composite the evaluator built from a roster the evaluator chose is not an independent yardstick, so it earns at most 1 of 2

comparison.statistic: relative wealth ratio vs peer composite
comparison.comparator_kind: appraisal-based peer composite constructed by the evaluator, not a market series
comparison.not_pme_note: Not a public market equivalent: the peer composite is appraisal-based, constructed by the evaluator and cannot be bought.
comparison.window_note: 5 overlapping fiscal year(s) of 5 composite years
comparison.alignment_note: aligned by fiscal year-end year. Members' fiscal years end in month 03 (cliffwater_cclfx), 12 (bcred, cion_ares, ocic), the fund's in month 06

composite.weighting: equal-weight across members reporting that fiscal year, aligned by fiscal year-end year. Stub and partial periods excluded

reasons: strategy_match 2/3: same asset class, different sub-strategy (direct lending vs multi-sector credit)
risk_liquidity_match 2/3: NAV-class series, quarterly observations vs the fund's daily return data and an index, not a fund set, so leverage regime is not comparable
investability 0/2: index cited, series not held, not computable
provider_independence 2/2: provider unaffiliated with the fund (Cliffwater): the registry affiliation map ties it to none of the fund's advisers
